name: Bamako
subtitle: Bamako, capital of Mali: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The award-winning Musée National and Grand Marché Dabanani showcase centuries of Dogon statuary, Bozo puppets, and authentic Bogolan mud-cloth.

parts.text: Following national independence in September 1960 under Modibo Keïta, Bamako expanded into a world capital of African music, photography, and literary festivals, crowned by the presidency on Koulouba hill.

gaps: Final microdata tables of the 2022 census round await completion by INSTAT.
First-hand local voices from Bogolan master dyers and Bozo river fishermen are missing.
